source.check: Cloughogue return read in the News-Letter nomination report of 17 May 1961; all other divisions from the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph (18 May 1961, p. 4).

note: Triennial election of Ballymena Rural District Council, June 1961 (statutory day Thursday 1 June 1961). There was no contest: all the sitting members were returned except in Cloughogue, where Mr. Oliver Given succeeded the retiring Mr. George C. Nelson. The returning officer's notice of result (Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 8 June 1961, p. 10) names every division: in Ballyconnolly, Glenwherry, Lisnagarron, Portglenone and Slemish, where no one was nominated, the retiring members were deemed re-elected; those five are taken from the notice, the others from the nomination report. Nominated unopposed. Returned unopposed.
